reason: APEX is primarily an agent-orchestration preset that coordinates a Pro model with bounded Flash workers for workspace code implementation, web validation, and read-only visual review.

summaries.zh: APEX 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体编排插件预设，用于协调主模型与受边界约束的子任务模型完成代码实现、网页验收和只读视觉复核。
summaries.en: APEX is a DeepSeek Harness orchestration preset that coordinates a primary model with bounded worker sessions for code implementation, web validation, and read-only visual review.

capabilities: Coordinates Pro and Flash model sessions for bounded code tasks
Modifies files within a workspace using an editor tool
Performs web searches through leased queries
Runs local browser-based validation for static web projects
